svg.title: Large first prompts: where Guffin is slower
svg.desc: MacBook Air M4 · 16 GiB · supplementary first replies · lower is faster. Both panels have the same zero-based linear scale; lower is faster. Internal TTFT excludes loading, tokenization and terminal transport. Default horizon row is Guffin H1 versus llama.cpp H3; final row matches H1 with other defaults unchanged. Two supplementary cases · matching first-prompt token counts · same linear scale from zero. Values in seconds: {"Code review": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 13.682924, "llama": 13.29514}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 20.725807, "llama": 17.09178}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 20.665201, "llama": 17.80472}, "gemma3-h1-vs-h1": {"guffin": 20.676417, "llama": 17.1335}}, "Document review": {"gemma2-release-v2": {"guffin": 34.349855, "llama": 31.95299}, "gemma3-normal-release-v2": {"guffin": 47.687072, "llama": 38.60264}, "gemma3-speculative-release": {"guffin": 47.695511, "llama": 39.12419}, "gemma3-h1-vs-h1": {"guffin": 47.319122, "llama": 38.31047}}}
